notes.body: never used after ?
Which field(s)? Most will have the potential for use in filters and post-capture analysis.
`offset += 2;`
No, offset is not used after. I was attempting to be consistent with prior code.
Original Size or PDU size ?
Original size. cPacket devices are packet brokers which may, at user direction, modify (remove headers, truncate, or remove payload) the packet before adding the GENEVE encapsulation.
rename hf and variable name ?

hi martin

can you share a pcap ?

can you also verified your account ?
Apologies for the delay in providing the pcap. We're undergoing some lab reconfiguration that has rendered the developmental system unavailable for a few days.

Hello Alexis.

I can provide a pcap in the next day or so. 

AFAIK, my account should be verified. I went through the email verification yesterday and added MFA today.
